title: Boring & no free version
body:
Super annoying having to install and go through 20-30 minutes of answering questions before seeing the price and that there is no free option just a 3 day trial

Also the games are super basic and boring. Nothing special and definitely not helpful for ADD
author: Mike3e101

title: Very useful app, with one downside
body: Great app, I enjoy playing these games and learning from them. Unfortunately the app doesn’t synchronize properly between my iPhone and iPad and therefore the progress is not even on both devices.
author: Lorenzo987
